about: Water names in Hawaii's reports that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for HI: the Department of Health Clean Water Branch's advisories (the newest 500 events, read on 2026-11-07: sewage spills, permit exceedances, Brown Water Advisories, beach advisories and retest notices), each name as the notices give it with diacritics and the okina folded (the feed spells a water both ways: Kane'ohe and Kaneohe), with the number of records giving it, the islands it is named on and the towns near it. The notices give no coordinates. A name two islands share has one row per island (island, place and slug_hint say which): build one record each (same_name_on_islands); the feed places a record only on a water of its own island. The towns are the Census places nearest each water, assigned by hand from the water's known place (the notices give no coordinates).

places_not_waters.note: records whose notice names a beach, park or shore and no water (Kalapaki Beach Park, North Shore): kept with no water
